credit.credit-words: I Am His, and He Is Mine
WORDS: George W. Robinson, 1876; alt. MUSIC: “Everlasting Love”; James Mountain, 1876. Public Domain.
I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies. Sng. 6:3 Your life is hid with Christ in God. Col. 3:3 All are yours; And ye are Christ's; and Christ is God's. 1 Cor. 3:22-23
